北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗，但体感 2℃，早晚注意保暖，别着凉！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny, but it feels like 2℃. Stay warm, especially morning and night!

深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and 26℃, a nice breeze. Remember to drink more water!
